top_signals.title: PHP/USD: Philippine Peso Falls Past 62 Per Dollar on Elevated Oil Prices
top_signals.summary: The Philippine peso weakened past 62 per dollar on Friday, breaching a closely-watched level and adding pressure on the benchmark stock index as the gauge posted its biggest monthly drop since March.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.

top_signals.title: Let’s talk about ‘S&X,’ baby: Netflix drama on sexuality falls flat
top_signals.summary: The Netflix series tries to destigmatize conversations about sex with unflinching honesty, but flattens the story in the process.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Digital asset volatility and institutional crypto positioning changes.
